title: India Just Passed Japan In GDP
source: IMF World Economic Outlook (nominal GDP, current prices) and World Bank national accounts data, 2015-2025. India's nominal GDP grew from $2.10T (2015) to $2.72T (2018), $2.68T (2020), $3.35T (2022) and $3.91T (2024); Japan's slid from $4.12T (2015) to a 2018-2020 peak near $5.05-5.07T before a weak yen pulled it to $4.26T (2022) and $4.03T (2024). The IMF's 2025 projection puts India at $4.187T against Japan's $4.186T — India overtaking Japan as the world's 4th-largest economy, reported April/May 2025 (IMF, NITI Aayog).
